newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Treasure in HK$54 mln assets swap.
newsitem.headline: China Treasure in HK$54 mln assets swap.

text.p: China Treasure Telecom Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it had agreed to sell its entire 9.3 percent stake in Open View Properties Ltd to third party Hui Yan The People Prefecture Investment Ltd for HK$54 million.
China Treasure agreed to buy the entire share capital of Jet Power Ltd from Hui Yan at the same price, it said.
Hui Yan previously owned 90.7 percent of Open View, a company which holds interests in property projects in Hong Kong.
The sole asset of Jet Power is the contractual right to acquire the land use right to an industrial site at a technology development zone in Huiyang City in China's Guangdong province.
